paragraphs.text: Mordenkainen is a blue -aligned human wizard , featured in Dungeons & Dragons: Adventures in the Forgotten Realms .
A prolific archmage from the world of Oerth who was responsible for many powerful and useful spells.
Though depicted on a planeswalker card, Mordenkainen is not a planeswalker within Magic lore.
The −2 ability on his card summons a Mordenkainen's faithful hound .
